steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: We're almost there... Cecelia, do you know these streets?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Um... I've seen these houses before... but there's a lot of the same houses...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Did you just move here recently?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Move? I don't remember moving...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Sorry, Mister Ezell, Mamma always took me outside at night. The roads look different in the dark.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: But I like to sneak peeks out the window to see what it's like outside... so I think I can do it! I'll try...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: It's okay, Cecelia, we'll find it. We haven't reached the place I met you yet.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Eyah!

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Sorry... I was looking at the houses, I didn't see you.

steps.name: Ardent Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Hm? Aren't you that girl who fainted and went to the hospital this morning? Are you alright now?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Oh, it's you! Um, she's... she's fine.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Say, did anyone come looking for her?

steps.name: Ardent Lateran Citizen
steps.text: I stayed on watch until noon! But nobody showed up. It's strange. What are her parents up to?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Cecelia says she lives right around here. You're sure you've never seen her?

steps.name: Ardent Lateran Citizen
steps.text: I'd definitely remember seeing such an adorable little girl! I suppose I don't need to stand around here worrying my head off anymore.

steps.name: Ardent Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Actually, going to talk to the neighborhood hall isn't the worst idea. If her family's just moved in here, then they'll be sure to have records.

steps.name: Ardent Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Ooh, lucky, that's Paula right there!

steps.name: Ardent Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Seniora Paula! Over here!

steps.name: Intellectual Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Hm, what's the matter? I'm running back to the hall right now, so let's walk and talk.

steps.name: Ardent Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Have we had any new households move in recently?

steps.name: Intellectual Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Of course we have... but how recently are you talking?

steps.name: Ardent Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Do you remember roughly when you moved in, little miss?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: ...didn't just move... been living here a really long time...

steps.name: Intellectual Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Huh? Little lady, can I have your name?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: I'm Cecelia...

steps.name: Intellectual Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Hm... that doesn't make sense. I've been working here for over a decade. If you moved in a long time ago...

steps.name: Intellectual Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Cecelia, do you know your mama and papa's names?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Mamma's name is... Feoria.

steps.name: Intellectual Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Wha-Wh-What? Feoria, the one on Via Thervatius? Doesn't Feoria live alone? Where did she get a child as big as you?

steps.name: Intellectual Lateran Citizen
steps.text: But looking at you... you do bear a strong resemblance.

steps.name: Intellectual Lateran Citizen
steps.text: That's odd... illegitimate, really? Cecelia, when you say you've been living here long, you mean your mama?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Intellectual Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Are you looking for your mama?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Yeah, I want to find Mamma...

steps.name: Intellectual Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Well, then, senior, you must be... Feoria's relative or the like? Have you been fostering this girl out in the country? You've brought her to see her mother?

steps.name: Intellectual Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Never saw this coming. No wonder she'd always avoid any introductions... Such a grown child, all this time.

steps.name: Intellectual Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Excuse me, senior? Um? Are you alright?

steps.name: Intellectual Lateran Citizen
steps.text: We just about made it while we were talking. Feoria's house is right there. Should I knock on the door for you?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: ...7-265, Via Thervatius.

steps.name: Intellectual Lateran Citizen
steps.text: Huh? Oh, you know the address, then.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Yes. I do.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Mister Ezell, what's wrong? That look on your face...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: I'm fine, Cecelia.... Let's get our—you—um, home for now.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Come on, let's go.
The name.
Ever since finding Cecelia, the surprises have come so fast, it slipped my mind to even ask her 'what's your mama's name?'
The name...
An ill mother, white-clothed executor, people in gowns...
How do I tell Cecelia?
Where do I take her to find her mama, now?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: You're a Liberi. Why are you out to abduct a Sankta girl?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: You're a Liberi. Why are you PROTECTING a Sankta girl?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I'm protecting the Commandments of Laterano.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Commandments? When have the Sankta's commandments ever actually applied to Liberi?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Fiammetta, do you seriously believe Lateran Liberi are a part of Laterano?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: What makes us not? I was born here. I grew up here.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Listen. Do you know what you're even saying, Patia?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Of course I know...

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: You're the one who hasn't got it straight.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: The Liberi living in Laterano all take the Lateran Commandments as guiding principles, we believe in the 'Lateran teachings', we see Sankta as... living miracles!

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Firearms, commandments, halos, empathy...

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Suppose they're all Sankta miracles, sure! But do they have a single thing to do with Lateran Liberi?!

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Why do the Liberi have to believe in a miracle that will never, ever come to us?!

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: All of Laterano, all of the Lateran Church, belongs to nobody except the Sankta! Do you still not understand, Fiammetta?!

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Do you seriously believe you've become a part of them?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Too easy!

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Looks like you're not so staunch after all.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Fiammetta, Fiammetta. Think it over, carefully, I'm begging you...

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: I told you before I came from Iberia... do you know what it's like there? I can tell you, a lot of Iberians are even more devout than the Laterans.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: But what did they get for it?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: The people of Iberia have their fantasies of Laterano, thousands of miles away... That, I can understand.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: But why are the Lateran Liberi right there within reach, and still so delighted to give their lives for this bunch of Sankta partying about in their own closed-off golden age of forever?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Why, Fiammetta?! Tell me!

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Get out of the way.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: I'm wasting my breath, aren't I?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: You have your views, Patia.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: And I have mine.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Then tell me!

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Explain it! Why... would you rather chase something you know you'll never reach? Why aren't you willing to give even... one look behind?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I don't know what you're talking about.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Besides, is a smattering of words from me really going to change your mind?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: If a someone's views are so easy to change, then they can't be worth that much to begin with.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Get out of the way.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I know you're only here to stall me.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: But you know you can't hold me.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: We both have work to do.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Your companions are... practically no different from any civilian. Do you want them paying the price for you?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: You don't, Patia. So get out of the way, and save us both the effort.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: We're home, Cecelia.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Um... I don't have the key, I can't get in... Mister Ezell, can you...

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Are you really okay? Do you feel bad...? You've been looking down for a while.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: I'm fine. Let me get the door open...

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Why did the lady just now say you actually knew our address?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Cecelia, do you recognize this firearm?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Is this—Mamma's guardian gun?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Mister Ezell... why do you have Mamma's gun...?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: I'm sorry, Cecelia...

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Sorry for what...?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: I don't really understand.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: You... You know where Mamma is, don't you?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Yes, I do... I'm sorry, Cecelia.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: I'm sorry... I don't know why I'm apologizing, either... I'm sorry.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Cecelia—your mother—passed away.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: She's not here anymore.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: If she's not here, where is she then? What does... 'passed away' mean?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: I remember, this morning, Mamma said she was going somewhere, and she couldn't take me with her... Did you go there with her, Mister Ezell?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Can you... take me there too? Just once, just for a little bit?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: I—I won't be selfish, and I'll listen to Mamma, and I won't stay there and say I won't leave... so... so...

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Can you let me see Mamma one more time?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: I haven't said goodbye to her yet.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Uh, what's happening? Why is she crying, Ezell? Just what did you do to a poor little girl?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Who are you? Hold on, that uniform... You're a Legatus?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Very sharp eyes, Senior Ezell.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: By order of His Holiness the Pope, I'm here to take Cecelia to the Basilica.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Whoops, forgot to introduce myself. My name's Oren Argiolas. If you want to check my identity, no harm in using your regulation terminal from the Hall there.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Oh, no, forgot that too. You turned it off, didn't you?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: How did you find this place, then?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Senior Ezell, you underestimate a Legatus. You thought your movements would be hard to track? Or did you think you were so thorough, you left zero trace along the way?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Your Excellency... If you're going to take Cecelia away, can I at least ask you a few questions first?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Hahah, you're funny, senior. You think I have to answer what you ask?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: But I'm not such a cruel man... so shoot.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Just who is Cecelia?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Was she... born a fallen angel?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Colorful imagination, Ezell.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: But it's not as mysterious as you think.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Cecelia's mixed-blood, that's all.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: What? That's not possible... A Sankta's mixed-blood child can't be a Sankta!

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: There are very few cases of Sankta mixing blood with other races... but it's not rare enough to alarm the Lateran Curia...

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: You know the reason perfectly well, then.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Offspring of Sankta and other races don't become Sankta.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: A Sankta and Feline's child turns out Feline, a Sankta and Forte's child turns out Forte.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Mixed Sankta offspring don't get their halo and wings of light when they say their first word, and they can't empathetically sense other Sankta.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: To put it simply, they won't have any of the Sankta's distinguishing features. Without exception...

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: That's the generally accepted wisdom, anyway.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Cecelia is an exception.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: She's a Sankta who shouldn't have turned out as one.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: My second question is, should Cecelia is taken to the Basilica, how the Lateran Curia will... treat her?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: I don't know.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Don't give me that look, Ezell. If I was going to lie to you, I'd feed you a much kinder one, no problem.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: But the reality's what you see. Cecelia is an 'exception.' I couldn't tell you how the Pope is going to handle this.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: But this Holy Father of ours... I don't know what impression you have of him, but, well.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: At least, as I'm given to understand, he's not known to use extreme methods.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: And look at how cute Cecelia is. How hardhearted would someone have to be to harm her, right?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Third question.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: I cannot entirely trust your answers... I wish to accompany Cecelia to the Basilica.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Um, is that a question?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Sorry, but that's the one 'question' you'll have to forgive my answer on...
Oren, what are you doing here?
